description: Map IP addresses to origin ASNs with CAIDA's RouteViews prefix-to-AS snapshots, fetched on the fly or read from a local file.
rules: `--date YYYY-MM-DD` selects the newest CAIDA snapshot on or before that day. Only address families present in the input are loaded.
JSON, JSON Lines, CSV, TSV, and Parquet use columns ip, prefix, asn, origins, snapshot, and error. The terminal table folds every origin into asn.
asn is the first origin; origins keeps CAIDA's notation (A, A_B for multi-origin, A,B for an AS set). A multi-origin prefix is not ranked, so read origins or Match.asns().
Use Table.lookup_many or lookup_asns for bulk Python lookups; they release the GIL. Pass strict=False to turn invalid inputs into None.
Snapshots stay cached until pruned. --offline never downloads. --cache prune needs --keep-days N or --keep-last N; --dry-run only reports.
